verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an AI-powered accounting SaaS that processes user financial data, so a training opt-out or no-training privacy commitment is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions model-training policies, an opt-out control, or any commitment not to train on customer data. The AI features, MCP integration and export docs describe how AI is used, not whether user data is excluded from training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
